llm.summary: This skill reads scoped student learning records to draft renewal reports, with clear limits on consent, sending, and record changes.

dimensions.detail: The Chinese-language Mainland China K12 scope is explicit and coherent with the content, but operators outside that context would need localization of language, law, and crisis resources.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown/JSON documentation and schema files only; I found no executable installer, dependency fetch, remote payload execution, or tool replacement behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions require a specific student alias and report/renewal intent before reading records, forbid cross-student scans, require parent-facing consent checks, and keep sending manual.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It uses platform workspace persistence, but narrows writes to this skill's progressEvidence entries, provides pause/delete/export controls, and defers student status changes or full deletion to another managed workflow.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill handles sensitive K12 learning records and writes limited progressEvidence entries, but this is disclosed and directly supports its report-generation purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use this skill only where its Chinese Mainland K12 assumptions fit, or localize the language, legal references, and crisis-help channels first. Before installing, be comfortable with it reading one named student's lesson logs, homework followups, course package data, consent fields, and parent-communication summaries to draft reports; it should not send messages, scan all students, change student status, or delete student profiles.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger example is bounded by SKILL.md's requirement to confirm a concrete student and report type before reading records; casual status chat is explicitly excluded from the report workflow.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only guidance is consistent with the artifact's explicit Mainland China Chinese K12 deployment scope and localization warnings, so I treat it as disclosed regional targeting rather than hidden language coercion.
